# Scientific American

> > Scientific American (SciAm) is a leading science journalism publication covering research, discoveries, and innovations across all scientific disciplines, published by Springer Nature America, Inc.

The site offers digital and print subscription plans with access to award-winning science journalism, multimedia content, and special projects like "The Protectors" documentary series on wildlife conservation. Available on iOS, Android, and web platforms.
